module: "Recce" tab of the rally editor. It loads the mission's recce recording (driveline + "cuts", via gameplay/rally/recce), displays the number of points and the length of the driveline, lets you downsample it (straightness threshold between 0.98 and 1.0) and import one pacenote per cut into the notebook. Can draw the driveline's timestamp labels in 3D. The module returns a class C constructor.
notes: No exported function: you get an instance with require(...)(rallyEditor).
The closer the straightness threshold is to 1, the more points are kept (UI tooltip).
In drawSectionV3, self.originalDrivelineSize and self.recce.driveline are used without a check if refresh() failed: possible error in that case.

init.desc: Constructor: stores rallyEditor; recce = nil, drawLabels = false.

selected.desc: Called when the tab is selected: reloads the recce (refresh) and emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

formatDistance.desc: Formats a distance as "123.456m", or in km above 950 m.

downsample.desc: Replaces the recce's driveline with a version downsampled according to straightnessThreshold.

drawSectionV3.desc: Draws the UI: refresh, labels, driveline/cuts info, Import button, Downsample button and threshold slider.

refresh.desc: Recreates the Recce object for the mission folder and loads the driveline and cuts; stores the original size. Logs an error on failure.

import.desc: Creates the pacenote data from the cuts, adds them to the notebook (appendPacenotes) and displays the Pacenotes tab.

draw.desc: Draws the tab (does nothing without a notebook).

drawDebugEntrypoint.desc: 3D debug drawing: calls recce:drawDebugRecce with the labels option.

mouseInfo.desc: Mouse information passed to the recce.
